goal: Tell Acme's finance team where competitors out-invest them in people (engineering, ML/AI, sales, marketing), check Acme's own spend files for errors, apply the spend policy, and support every number with a source.
plan: To identify where competitors out-invest Acme in people and to verify and apply spend policy with traceable sources, we will (1) load policy and internal budgets to establish the spend framework, (2) validate Acme's invoices against their totals, (3) enrich each competitor with headcount/funding context, (4) gather recent competitor job postings to gauge ML/AI hiring activity, and (5) classify competitors’ job titles to estimate ML/AI share. All inputs will be loaded before dependent analyses run, and every number produced will be backed by its source data. Note: policy application will be performed after data import/verification using the loaded policy guidance.
